nodes.label: Restaurant Interior - Dining Area with Street Art Mural
nodes.description: Interior shot of District Hamilton restaurant showing a casual dining area with exposed red brick walls, wooden dining tables with black chairs, and a large colorful street art / neo-expressionist painting mounted prominently on the brick wall. The artwork features bold, chaotic brushwork in pink, blue, green, and red tones with abstract urban imagery. A small candleholder lamp sits on one table, and a counter/bar area is visible on the right side with wine bottles and glassware. Natural light enters from a window on the left. The teal-painted floor adds a pop of color. The overall mood is edgy, artistic, and urban-chic.
nodes.setting: indoor restaurant dining room, exposed brick, mixed-use dining and bar counter space
nodes.purpose: showcase restaurant ambiance and interior design for website visitors; emphasizes the artistic and trendy character of the establishment
